steps.content: Anything that interests you?
You turn around. The "father" with the four-leaf clover head is standing behind you. His voice is calm and gentle.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Don't be nervous. I won't hurt you. You're investigating this room because you probably have questions about this world. I can answer them for you.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: This is Roulecca's dream. It's a world created by her subconscious mind. Ambrosia materialized the happiness she longed for, and cast all the painful memories out of this dream and into reality.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is this why Sleepwalkers spit out black goo in the real world?
How did you find out that it's a dream?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Really? Did my child spit out a lot of suffering in the real world?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Sorry for giving you trouble. Roulecca has been mischievous since she was a toddler. She must've put you through a lot.

steps.speaker: Options -1
options: I came here to stop her.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I know. You want to break this dream. But do you know what to do?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: How did you find out that it's a dream?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Like you, I made observations and reasonable guesses. This world has too many loose ends. In Roulecca's eyes, Daddy is the smartest person in the world, and the one who understands her best.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Even in a dream world created by Ambrosia, I can't let down my daughter's expectations of me.

steps.speaker: Options -1
options: You want to guard your daughter's sweet dream?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: That's what I wanted to ask you. Do you want to destroy this dream?

steps.speaker: Father

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Here, Roulecca is the rule. You can't use your strange power. If you go too far, you will be rejected by Roulecca. The dream will obey her subconscious and expel you back to reality.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When I get back to the real world, I will find a way to wake her up and stop the black four-leaf clovers from spreading.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: It's too late. This world has already matured and taken deep roots. As long as Roulecca still yearns for the Ambrosia-made "happiness" in her heart, she will never wake up from this dream.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Also, don't assume you can escape unharmed. Even if you are expelled from the dream, you will become part of the black goo. You will turn into a black four-leaf clover head, contaminating your "reality".
How terrible this is.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you here to stop me, or to threaten me?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Neither. I want you to take her away from here.
Roulecca's "father" sits down on the sofa, resting his elbows on the armrests and locking his fingers together. The eyeless four-leaf clover looks toward you.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I'm already dead. Ambrosia used Roulecca's longing for her family to create this doting hallucination to restrain and imprison her in a frozen past.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You're the only outsider. You are not created by her. And only you can dismantle all this. I will help you destroy this dream so that you and my daughter can return to reality together.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Awaken her. Make her understand that this is all fake, so that she can no longer get joy from it.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: When she no longer relies on Ambrosia, Ambrosia will stop attaining her happiness, and the dream will collapse. Roulecca will be able to escape the Sleepwalker's curse, and cease to cause trouble for your real world.
This doesn't sound like something a "doting hallucination" would say. It sounds like the words of a Syndicate casino boss.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why don't you awaken her yourself?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I can't do it. I am the father shaped by Roulecca's subconscious, an extremely doting father.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: If I'm forced to say anything that makes my dearest Roulecca cry... My mouth will rot away before the words come out.
...What strange things is this four-leaf clover head saying?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...I've tried many things, but none of them succeeded. I'm not able to destroy this world for her.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You can choose to not believe me, but there's no harm in listening to me. You don't want to be stuck here forever either, do you?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Roulecca likes you very much, and also made you a promise. As long as you win the Diamond Medal in the next games, you can make a wish for Roulecca and make her leave.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: This is your plan anyways, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Will this world allow me to win?
Even if I win, will she keep her promise?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like you said, this place obeys her subconscious. If she doesn't want to lose, how can I win?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Just join the game and win against her fair and square. Roulecca will never cheat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If this mirage was born from her yearnings for you, would she be willing to leave just for a game?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Don't worry. Roulecca's a bit stubborn sometimes, but she never breaks a promise.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: She's a daughter of the four-leaf clovers. <color=#fb9259>"Win fairly and lose graciously"</color> is a rule she lives by, and also your best chance of winning.
But there's still something you're confused about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are also part of this dream. You were also created to dote on her and satisfy her every whim. But you are not like the other hallucinations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not only did you see through this dream, but you also want to go against your "daughter's" wishes and make her leave. Why is that?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...You don't need to worry about me, Chief. Don't overthink it. I'm not really human. I'm just here as the "father" from her memories.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: This is everything her "father" would do. That's all.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Good luck to you on the game tomorrow.
